# AMC Glass

<!-- Generated by tools/build-styles.mjs from style.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Universal Theme style** · light · built on vita · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A frosted glass style: translucent regions with light edges over a soft multi-color gradient page, a translucent header, strong dark text and a deep ocean-blue primary.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x:** Shared Components > Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_style_glass.sql`
  (Component Export) into an app on Universal Theme. It adds the style to Theme 42 and uploads
  `amc-styles/amc-style-glass.css` as a Static Application File. Then pick it in Theme Roller or
  Shared Components > Themes > Universal Theme > Styles (Set as Current), or let users pick it when
  Customization is enabled.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/styles/amc-glass.apx` and the static file, merge
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx`, and set `style.currentThemeStyle` in `theme.apx` to
  `@amc-glass` if it should be the default. Then run the apexlang gates.

Light style built on Vita. The page background is a soft pink, sky and lilac CSS gradient (no image). Regions, alerts, the header and the navigation are frosted glass: translucent white with a light edge and a background blur where the browser supports backdrop-filter; where it does not, they fall back to near-opaque white so text stays readable. Menus, popups and library components keep a near-opaque surface. Text is a strong dark navy and the primary color a deep ocean blue that passes WCAG AA with white text. Works with every AMC component and template, which read the same --ut-* variables. Refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page, including popups and dialogs.
